concerns.text: FR-004 (CPU-only enforcement) is partially covered by T004, but the spec requires this constraint to be enforced across ALL simulation, training, and inference. T012e verifies CPU-only execution, but there is no explicit task to enforce the CPU constraint in the `train.py` loop itself (beyond the T012e verification step). The plan requires 'System MUST perform all physics simulation... using only CPU resources' (FR-004). While T004 sets up the environment, the actual training loop (T012) and evaluation (T013) must explicitly inherit or re-verify this constraint to ensure no GPU fallback occurs during heavy computation. A dedicated task or explicit requirement in T012/T013 to assert CPU-only mode at runtime is missing.

FR-005 (Paired t-test) is covered by T015a and T015, but the spec requires the t-test to be executed 'across a diverse set of novel objects'. T013a generates 30 objects, but there is no explicit task to verify that the generated set is 'diverse' (e.g., covering the full friction range 0.1-1.2 as per FR-003 and US-1) before the t-test is run. The task T013b verifies existence and validity, but not the statistical diversity required for the t-test's validity. A task to validate the distribution of friction coefficients in the generated set (e.g., histogram check or range coverage) is missing.

SC-002 (10% improvement under varying friction) is mentioned in the spec but has no corresponding task. The spec states: 'The adaptive policy utilizing the estimator must achieve a task success rate at least 10% higher than a static-reward baseline under varying friction conditions'. While T015b and T015c validate SC-001 (15% improvement on high-friction), there is no task to specifically measure and log the 10% improvement under 'varying friction' (which implies a different test condition than just high-friction). This success criterion is untested.

T001c references 'coverage-efda7950' and 'ordering-a4b58b79' which appear to be internal tracking IDs from a previous iteration or a different project. These tags do not correspond to any FR/SC/US in the current spec.md or plan.md. This is a stale tag that should be removed or updated to reflect the current requirements (e.g., Constitution Principle III for checksums).
